visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation starts with a minimalist white background. Centered black text appears as a title. In the seat directly in front, a man in a purple shirt with tall, spiky black hair sits down, completely obstructing the blue-shirted man's field of vision. (3) The camera shifts to a medium shot. To the left of the main character, a man in an olive green shirt holds a glowing smartphone, casting a bright white light on his face. The main character looks at him with visible irritation and sweat on his brow, indicated by a blue droplet animation. (4) An elderly man with gray hair and a navy blue shirt enters the frame from behind. He has an angry facial expression with furrowed brows and an open mouth as he shouts. Red text captions appear above him to represent his dialogue. The background remains the dark red seating of the theater. She has her mouth open and eyes closed, with blue 'Z' symbols floating around her. She holds a purple cup with a straw. Two men sit behind her looking annoyed and sweating. Large bold text appears on the screen alongside his rapid movement. (7) A man wearing glasses and a green shirt is shown in a close-up. He is stuffing his face with multiple hot dogs and holding a large bucket of popcorn. His cheeks are bulging, and crumbs are visible. A red soda cup with a yellow straw sits in the foreground. (8) Two young men sit in the red seats, whispering to each other. One wears a black jacket, the other an orange shirt. They point toward the screen. The main character, sitting behind them, looks extremely frustrated with darkened eyes and a drop of sweat on his temple. (9) A romantic scene unfolds between a blonde woman in a pink shirt and a man in a black shirt. The woman is crying into a pink tissue, then they hold hands and look lovingly at each other. The background turns bright pink with floating red and white heart icons. (10) The final shot returns to the main character in the blue shirt. He stares blankly at the camera with wide eyes and a single large blue sweat drop on his forehead. The background is a stark white and blue striped pattern, typical of a comedic reaction shot.

The BGM continues steadily in the background without any noticeable shifts in volume or tempo. The narrator speaks at a moderate rate, his tone becoming increasingly sarcastic and mock-annoyed. (4) The audio texture shifts dramatically as a new, older male voice shouts loudly. This voice is strained, high-volume, and authoritative. There is no BGM during this outburst, creating a strategic silence in the music bed to emphasize the dialogue. A soft, whimsical BGM with woodwind textures fades in. (6) Frantic, high-pitched vocalizations from a male character occur, suggesting physical distress. These are layered over rapid, percussive footstep SFX on a hard surface. The BGM tempo seems to increase slightly to reflect the urgency of the scene. (7) Loud, wet crunching and chewing SFX dominate the audio mix. These sounds have high percussiveness and a wide frequency range. The narrator makes a 'yum' sound, and the BGM transitions to a more playful, staccato rhythm. (8) Two distinct male voices are heard whispering at a very low intensity. One voice has a rising intonation asking a question. This is followed by a sudden, short 'ugh' sound from the main character, indicating annoyance. (9) The BGM shifts to a sentimental, melodic piano track. A woman's high-pitched sobbing is audible, followed by a male voice with a gentle, friendly tone. A loud, wet 'smack' SFX represents a kiss, accompanied by a magical 'shimmer' SFX. (10) The video ends with a classic comedic 'slide whistle' SFX that starts high and ends low.
